name: Observability and Operations
summary: Seeing what is happening in production — and acting before the user notices. Starting with instrumenting the service yourself, because nothing is visible that was not made visible.
prerequisites: Requires something already running to observe. The pipeline that deploys the agent is not assumed.

SLI, SLO, error budget and an alert worth waking up for
The incident: on-call, severity, communication and the blameless postmortem
